demos.name: HITL MFA Lab
demos.description: A third-party weather MCP server scoped at an agent gateway: a live, admin-editable state policy is enforced entirely at the edge — a denied call never reaches the backend, and switching the policy flips the SAME call, no restart. Standalone mock of the AI-DEMO2 weather-mcp showcase (UC30/UC31/UC32). Mock + owner-run Real.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7680). Mock needs no tenant and no credentials. Docker: HOST_PORT=7680 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). The scope contract mirrors the AI-DEMO2 tx-weather-scope gateway policy (UC30 permit, UC31 deny, UC32 live reconfigure). Repo: curtismu7/hitl-mfa-lab. Catalog id pending owner assignment.
